info.title: Web教辅系统 API
info.description: Web教辅系统后台接口文档，覆盖管理端、学员端、UE三维程序和测试联调接口。

tags.name: Admin Account
tags.description: Teacher and student account management APIs.

tags.name: Student Training
tags.description: Student training center and team room APIs. Header X-User-Id identifies the student.

tags.name: Admin Education Config
tags.description: Academic year, semester, major, and class configuration APIs.

tags.name: Student Messages
tags.description: Student notification and read-state APIs. Header X-User-Id identifies the student.

tags.name: Admin Score Config
tags.description: Comprehensive score weight and grade rule configuration APIs.

tags.name: Admin Papers
tags.description: Theory paper APIs for manual assembly, automatic assembly, publishing, and logs.

tags.name: Admin Questions
tags.description: Theory question bank APIs for CRUD, status changes, logs, and import previews.

tags.name: Admin Assignment Review
tags.description: Teacher review APIs for submitted course assignments.

tags.name: Auth
tags.description: Login APIs for admin and student portals.

tags.name: Student Archives
tags.description: Student training archive query APIs. Header X-User-Id identifies the student.

tags.name: Health
tags.description: Service health check API.

tags.name: Admin Courses
tags.description: Teaching course lifecycle, publication, content, statistics, and operation logs.

tags.name: Student Scores
tags.description: Student comprehensive score APIs. Header X-User-Id identifies the student.

tags.name: Admin Facility Config
tags.description: Classroom and NVR camera configuration APIs.

tags.name: Student Resources
tags.description: Student public resource query APIs.

tags.name: Student Profile
tags.description: Student profile and password APIs. Header X-User-Id identifies the student.

tags.name: Student Courses
tags.description: Student course learning APIs. Header X-User-Id identifies the student.

tags.name: Student Assignments
tags.description: Student theory assignment APIs. Header X-User-Id identifies the student.

tags.name: Admin Organization
tags.description: Organization tree management APIs.

tags.name: Admin Resources
tags.description: Personal resources, public review applications, and public resource library APIs.

put.description: Updates the current student's phone number.
Changes the current student's password after validating the current password and password policy.
Updates the current student's ID card number.

get.description: Returns score grade rules sorted from high score to low score.

put.description: Replaces all grade rules after validating that score ranges do not overlap.

get.description: Returns one personal resource with file metadata and public version state.

put.description: Updates resource metadata, creates a new version, and preserves older public version state when applicable.
Batch updates selected resources using only provided cover, major, or course fields.

get.description: Returns one question with normalized options and standard answer.

put.description: Updates question body, score, answer, and options while preserving historical paper snapshots.

get.description: Returns one paper with immutable question snapshots and scores.

put.description: Rebuilds paper question snapshots and total score from the submitted paper definition.
Updates an organization node and rejects self-parenting.

get.description: Returns one course with teachers, classes, chapters, and content nodes.

put.description: Updates course metadata and fully replaces submitted teachers, classes, chapters, and content nodes.

get.description: Returns one classroom and its camera list.

put.description: Updates classroom name and replaces the submitted camera list.

delete.description: Deletes the classroom and its camera records.

put.description: Updates editable teacher profile fields and replaces role, managed organization, and teaching class bindings.
Replaces the teacher role bindings and returns an empty success response.
Updates editable student profile fields without changing the account number.

post.description: Creates a team training room for the current student and returns room state.
Starts a waiting team room after owner, capacity, and role completion checks.
Claims a room role for the current student and returns updated room state.
Removes the current student from a team room and dissolves waiting rooms when the owner leaves.
Adds the current student to a waiting team room and returns room state.
Marks one student notification as read.
Marks all unread notifications for the current student as read.
Saves courseware study seconds and completion state for the current student.
Submits the assignment, triggers objective scoring, and returns the submission result.
Saves draft answers for an editable assignment and returns an empty success response.
Authenticates a student account and returns token, expiry time, and user profile.
Authenticates an admin or teacher account and returns token, expiry time, and user profile.
Clears existing current semester flags and marks the requested semester as current.

get.description: Returns score weight history, optionally filtered by semester.

post.description: Creates a new score weight history record. Header X-User-Id identifies the admin operator.

get.description: Returns paged personal resources filtered by name, type, major, course, uploader, status, or upload date.

post.description: Creates resource metadata, detects type from file suffix, and starts with NOT_APPLIED public status.
Submits the resource current version for public review and marks the resource as PENDING.
Soft deletes resources after checking that selected resources are not bound to courses.

get.description: Returns paged question bank entries filtered by keyword, type, creator, or enabled state.

post.description: Creates a theory question and derives choice answers from correct option flags.
Marks a question available for future manual or automatic paper assembly.
Disables a question without removing already published paper snapshots.
Validates parsed Excel rows and returns valid row count plus row-level errors.
Rejects a pending application; review comment is required for rejection.
Approves a pending application, publishes the submitted version, and notifies all enabled students.

get.description: Returns paged theory papers filtered by name, assembly mode, creator, or publish status.

post.description: Creates a manual or automatic paper and stores question snapshots for historical consistency.
Publishes a non-empty paper for student-side exam use.
Marks a published paper offline while preserving its historical records.
Validates parsed Excel rows for manual or automatic paper definitions and returns row-level errors.
Creates an organization node and returns the new organization id.
Enables an organization node.
Disables an organization node.

get.description: Returns all majors with enabled status.

post.description: Creates a major and returns the new major id.
Enables a major for selection.
Disables a major for selection.

get.description: Returns paged teaching courses filtered by name, term, major, class, teacher, or publish status.

post.description: Creates a draft teaching course with teachers, classes, chapters, courseware, and assignment nodes.
Publishes a non-empty course and sends course notifications to bound students.
Soft deletes a course and takes it offline.
Copies a course as a draft with its teachers, classes, chapters, and content structure.
Marks a course offline while preserving learning and assignment records.

get.description: Returns classrooms with configured NVR camera metadata.

post.description: Creates a classroom with at least one NVR camera and returns the new classroom id.

get.description: Returns classes, optionally filtered by major id.

post.description: Creates a class under a major and returns the new class id.
Persists per-question scores, marks the attempt REVIEWED, and refreshes course progress.
Enables login for the selected account.
Disables login for the selected account.

get.description: Returns paged teacher accounts with masked sensitive fields.

post.description: Creates a teacher account with hashed configured initial password and returns the new user id.

get.description: Returns paged student accounts with class, organization, and masked sensitive fields.

post.description: Creates a student account bound to a class and returns the new user id.
Resets selected accounts to the configured initial password hash without returning plaintext passwords.
Updates the belonging organization for selected accounts.

get.description: Returns academic years with their semesters.

post.description: Creates an academic year and automatically creates FIRST and SECOND semesters.

get.description: Returns published trainings visible to the current student.
Returns UE training application installation status for the current student.
Returns room members and role claims for the current student.
Returns comprehensive semester scores for the current student.
Returns public resources filtered by keyword, resource type, or major.
Returns the current student's profile.
Returns the current student's notifications and unread count.
Returns published courses visible to the current student.
Returns course detail, chapter content tree, and learning progress.
Returns assignment questions, answers, and current submission status.
Returns scoring report and answer details after submission.
Returns the current student's training archives filtered by mode or keyword.
Returns one training archive detail for the current student.
Returns service status, service name, and current server time.
Returns operation logs for one resource sorted by newest first.
Returns operation logs for one question sorted by newest first.
Returns paged approved public resources; only the latest approved version per source resource is shown.
Returns paged resource public applications filtered by resource fields or review status.
Returns one public review application with the submitted resource version snapshot.
Returns operation logs for one paper sorted by newest first.
Returns the sorted organization tree with children nested under their parent nodes.
Returns student completion counts, pending review count, and average assignment score.
Returns operation logs for one course sorted by newest first.
Returns paged student assignment attempts filtered by course, assignment, class, student, status, or keyword.
Returns submitted answers, standard answers, and current review scores for one attempt.
Returns review operation logs for one assignment attempt sorted by newest first.
Returns one account detail with phone and ID card masked.
